task.description: Full fresh idiom/supervision/scope-creep/decision-record-consistency review of commit 77c1d1e. Check: (1) OTP idiom of the new prove_capability_instantiation/2 private function and its reuse of classify_crash/1 -- is it genuinely reusing existing logic or duplicating it with drift; (2) whether the new registration proof's Task.Supervisor.async_nolink/2 call under the shared ModuleVersionRegistryTaskSupervisor is idiomatically consistent with the module's own invoke/4 usage of the same supervisor; (3) confirm module_registry.ex/capability_gate.ex/plugin_handler.ex remain genuinely untouched (git diff --stat since 8d4157a); (4) confirm the data-model rename (registered_module -> bytes) was applied consistently everywhere (commit_version, checkout, status_for, apply_release_predicate, do_invoke) with no stale reference to the old type/field name anywhere, including in comments/docs; (5) TEST-DESIGNER's test file was modified by ELIXIR-DEV (the first describe block's 3 tests, which pre-dated the design rework and asserted the OLD, now-incorrect behavior) -- confirm this was a legitimate, narrowly-scoped correction (the tests were asserting a defect as if it were a spec) and not scope creep or a rewrite that quietly weakens coverage; (6) scope creep -- confirm the diff stays confined to what the fix required.
acceptance_criteria: a test holds an invocation open (a guest blocked in a controllable host call), activates a new module version DURING it, and asserts the held invocation completes normally against the OLD version's observable behaviour -- WASM-14's own acceptance criterion, with the overlap real rather than sequential
the same test asserts an invocation started AFTER the activation observes the NEW version's behaviour, so both halves of WASM-14 are proven in one overlapping scenario
a test asserts the prior version's resources are released only after its last in-flight invocation completes, not at activation time
a module requiring at least one host capability can be successfully registered via register_version/3 -- verified by the actual test passing, not merely asserted
